valuation.note: Kenneth chose forward P/E (30 Sep) over EV/Sales. Only Iridium (28.0x) is inside the 2x-80x data-quality range, so VL1 rests on one peer: shown under Known defects.

dm4.name: Connectivity (Starlink) revenue growth
dm4.source: SpaceX quarterly results release, revenue by segment (on results)
dm4.what: Growth in Starlink revenue (home, business, aviation, maritime, government, direct-to-phone) vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: Starlink is over half of revenue and the main source of cash. Revenue (not subscriber count) is used because revenue per subscriber is lower than a year ago (revenue +66% while subscribers doubled), even though management says it held at $66 a month vs the March quarter.
dm4.bull_means: Starlink revenue is growing fast: the core business is healthy.
dm4.neutral_means: Starlink growth is slowing to a moderate pace.
dm4.bear_means: Starlink growth has slowed sharply: a hit to the business that funds everything else.

dm4.name: AI (xAI) revenue growth
dm4.source: SpaceX quarterly results release, revenue by segment (on results)
dm4.what: Growth in AI revenue (Grok subscriptions and API, X advertising, and renting out AI computing capacity) vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: A third of revenue and where most of the spending goes ($15.8bn of the $18.4bn June-quarter capex); it must grow very fast to justify the investment. Growth is driven by computing contracts, mainly one customer (12.2% of company revenue in the 6 months to June).
dm4.bull_means: AI revenue is growing at the pace the valuation needs.
dm4.neutral_means: AI growth is solid but not exceptional.
dm4.bear_means: AI growth has slowed well below what the spending assumes.

dm4.name: Space (launch) revenue growth
dm4.source: SpaceX quarterly results release, revenue by segment (on results)
dm4.what: Growth in launch, Dragon and government space revenue vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: The smallest segment, but it is the base the rest is built on and shows demand from NASA, defence and commercial customers.
dm4.bear_means: Launch revenue is flat or shrinking.

dm5.name: Google search interest in 'Starlink'
dm5.source: Google Trends, worldwide, weekly index: average of the last 4 complete weeks vs the same 4 weeks a year earlier (tested live 30 Sep 2026: works from trends.google.com)
dm5.what: How often people search Google for 'Starlink' in the latest month vs the same month last year.
dm5.why: An outside, early read of consumer interest that arrives before SpaceX reports subscribers. It is noisy: news such as Starship flights, outages or Musk headlines also moves it.
